label: Mufti OEE reference: ref_target_seed
info: Writes the reference table ref_target_seed to the data lake. Read calls only against Insights Hub.

name: [1] TRIGGER & CONFIG
info: STAGE 1 - TRIGGER AND CONFIG. Writes the table ref_target_seed to the data lake. Schedule: weekly, Monday 07:00 UTC. The Run now button starts it by hand. Both go through 1.1 CONFIG, the only node to edit: output path, dry-run switch, credentials, asset list. dryRun is true by default: set it to false to write the file. The file name is fixed, so every run replaces the file.

name: 1.1 CONFIG (edit here)
1.2 Build run message
[2] SETUP
info: STAGE 2 - token request, OEE asset list, choose the assets. Function nodes cannot use fetch in the VFC, so every call is an http request node: the function before it sets msg.method, msg.url and msg.headers. A failure goes to the LOG and nothing is written.

name: 2.1 Build token request
2.2 Build asset list request
2.3 Choose assets
[3] ASSET TARGETS
info: STAGE 3 - One message per asset. GET the OEE asset (thresholds: warning and error per KPI), then one row per KPI. These are the KPI targets set in Insights Hub (0 = not set). Loss and category targets are not in the API.

name: 3.1 Build thresholds request
3.2 Build target rows
[4] JOIN & DECIDE
info: STAGE 4 - The join waits for all items. Collect puts the rows in one list. Decide writes NOTHING if any item failed (no half tables) and nothing in dry-run mode. Output 1 = the rows for the parquet node, output 2 = the log.

name: 4.1 Collect rows
4.2 Decide write
[5] WRITE ref_target_seed
info: STAGE 5 - parquet node, path and write object for ref_target_seed. The path comes from CONFIG. Types: UTF8 (STRING), BOOLEAN, INT64, DOUBLE, TIMESTAMP_MILLIS (epoch ms).

name: 5.1 Set path
[6] LOG
info: STAGE 6 - LOG. Every log line arrives here through the link "to LOG": one line per run (debug sidebar): row count, skipped assets, FAILED / NOTHING WRITTEN, or the dry-run row count and first rows.
